messages.author: f6e92ac44637af80
messages.subject: my data table is getting rendered on top of the bubble plot at the click of node..
parts:
At the click of each node the data table getting rendered on top of the bubble plot instead of next to it. Can someone please help?


ui.R

====

 

library(shiny)

library(jsonlite)

library(DT)

 

shinyUI(fixedPage(

  br(),

  titlePanel("Bubble Plot"),

  hr(),

 

  mainPanel(

    fluidPage(        

      tags$head(

        tags$style(HTML("

                        text {

                        font: 10px sans-serif;

                        };

                        "))

        ),

      #load D3JS library

      tags$script(src="https://d3js.org/d3.v3.min.js"),

     

      column(6,

             #create div referring to div in the d3script

             tags$div(id="div_tree", width='50%'),

             #h3(textOutput("Components")),

             #load javascript

             tags$script("

                         var diameter = 500,

                         format = d3.format(',d'),

                         color = d3.scale.category20c();

                         var bubble = d3.layout.pack()

                         .sort(null)

                         .size([500, 500])

                         .padding(1.5);

                        

                         var svg = d3.select('#div_tree').append('svg')

                         .attr('width', diameter)

                         .attr('height', diameter)

                         .attr('class', 'bubble');

                        

                         var tooltip = d3.select('#div_tree')

                         .append('div')

                         .style('position', 'absolute')

                         .style('z-index', '10')

                         .style('visibility', 'hidden')

                         .style('color', 'white')

                         .style('padding', '8px')

                         .style('background-color', 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)')

                         .style('border-radius', '6px')

                         .style('font', '12px sans-serif')

                         .style('width','50%')

                         .text('tooltip');

                        

                         d3.json('flare1.json', function(error, root) {

                         var node = svg.selectAll('.node')

                         .data(bubble.nodes(classes(root))

                         .filter(function(d) { return !d.children; }))

                         .enter().append('g')

                         .attr('class', 'node')

                         .attr('transform', function(d) { return 'translate(' + d.x + ',' + d.y + ')'; });

                        

                         node.append('circle')

                         .attr('r', function(d) { return d.r; })

                         .style('fill', function(d) { return color(d.value); })

                         .on('click', function(d) {

                         Shiny.onInputChange('clickedValue', d.className)

                         })

                         .on('mouseover', function(d) {

                         tooltip.text(d.className + ': ' + format(d.value));

                         tooltip.style('visibility', 'visible');

                         })

                         .on('mousemove', function() {

                         return tooltip.style('top', (d3.event.pageY-10)+'px').style('left',(d3.event.pageX+10)+'px');

                         })

                         .on('mouseout', function(){return tooltip.style('visibility', 'hidden');});

                        

                         node.append('text')

                         .attr('dy', '.3em')

                         .style('text-anchor', 'middle')

                         .style('pointer-events', 'none')

                         .text(function(d) { return d.className.substring(0, d.r / 3); });

                         });

                        

                         // Returns a flattened hierarchy containing all leaf nodes under the root.

                         function classes(root) {

                         var classes = [];

                        

                         function recurse(name, node) {

                         if (node.children) node.children.forEach(function(child) { recurse(node.name, child); });

                         else classes.push({packageName: name, className: node.name, value: node.size});

                         }

                        

                         recurse(null, root);

                         return {children: classes};

                         }

                        

                         d3.select(self.frameElement).style('height', diameter + 'px');

                         

                         ")        

    ),

              column(6,dataTableOutput("results")

                    )#column

    )#fluid page

  )#main panel

 

) # fixed page

)#shiny UI

 

Server.R

===========

 

library(shiny)

library(rjson)

library(dplyr)

library(DT)

 

shinyServer(

  function(input, output, session) {

  

      wc_click <- reactive({

        a <- input$clickedValue

        print(a)

      })

     

      data <- reactive({

        val <- wc_click()

        if(!is.null(val))

        {

        filesdata <-filter(filesdata,Components==val)

        }

      })

     

      output$results <- renderDataTable({

        data()

      })

  }

)

messages.subject: Re: my data table is getting rendered on top of the bubble plot at the click of node..
parts:
The indentation makes it very hard to read... I'd recommend you move your JavaScript into a separate .js file and include it using either a script tag or the includeScript R function. And highlight your ui.R and press Ctrl+i (or Cmd+i on Mac) to auto-indent your R code, then do the same on server.R.

Perhaps change your outer fixedPage to fluidPage, and remove the inner fluidPage.

Also it looks like you're hard-coding the size of the bubble chart to 500 x 500, rather than scaling it with the size of its container.
